subject: Dedicated capacity sizing intake - Veridian Reserved Fleet
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@veridian.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Oct 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial sizing inputs for dedicated capacity (Veridian)

Hi Irene / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move to a reserved capacity conversation and want your help sizing a modest pilot that can scale to production. I attached a CSV with a sampled week of traffic and some quick averages. Key signals below: 

- Peak API QPS observed: 185 (10-minute rolling peak)
- Typical request type mix: 60% chat (stateful sessions), 30% single-turn generation, 10% embeddings/rerank
- Avg prompt tokens (chat): 45; avg response tokens (chat): 420
- Avg prompt tokens (single-turn): 120; avg response tokens: 90
- Session length (KV cache alive): median 7 turns, 95th percentile 26 turns
- Target P95 tail latency for chat responses: 750 ms
- Expected business-critical hours: US East 13:00-20:00 ET

Our goal: reliable 99.9% uptime and predictable per-token economics for the pilot month, then commit to quarterly reserved capacity if numbers look good. Can you confirm what additional telemetry you need (burst headroom, session affinity, prefix cache hit rates, etc.) and provide an initial sizing estimate / info required to finalize a term sheet?

Samir (cc) will own sharing logs and the sample telemetry. Appreciate a short checklist we can act on.

Best,
Jordan
Co-founder, Veridian AI

Attachments: veridian_token_profile.csv (CSV sample of 7 days)
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@veridian.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Oct 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial sizing inputs for dedicated capacity (Veridian)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the CSV and the high-level signals — this is a great starting point. To produce a defensible pilot sizing and the draft term sheet we need a short set of additional fields and one small instrumentation sample: 

Action checklist (please return the redwood_sizing_template.xlsx we attached):
1) Per-route QPS time series (1-5 min granularity) for the sample week — separate chat vs single-turn vs embeddings.
2) Distribution of response token lengths (histogram) for chat and single-turn. A rough percentile table (p50/p90/p99) is fine.
3) Example session lifecycle: average number of warm vs cold sessions per hour and TTL for KV cache.
4) Cache hit estimate for prefix/KV reuse (if unknown, we can model conservative 20%/optimistic 60%).
5) Peak simultaneous sessions during business-critical hours (not just QPS).
6) Any hard latency SLOs per route and budget for SLO violations during burst windows.

What we’ll deliver after we get that back (timeline in parentheses):
- Pilot sizing: GPU SKU mix + reserve units + recommended burst buffer (48 hours) (48 hours)
- Cost and latency trade-off memo with quantized model options (72 hours)
- Draft term sheet with commit and fallback policy (5 business days)

Technical notes / questions:
- For chat sessions, confirm whether you keep full conversation context or truncate older turns (we model KV cache size accordingly).
- Do any routes require function/tool calling or large streaming outputs (>=2k tokens) — those materially change throughput math.

I’ll run a quick back-of-envelope with Marissa and Karthik once you send the template. If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the template together — propose 10am ET.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sizing_template.xlsx (please populate and return)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@veridian.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Oct 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial sizing inputs for dedicated capacity (Veridian)

Looping in a quick back-of-envelope before we get the full histogram: using Jordan’s peaks and the token averages, high-level estimate for pilot (conservative assumptions):

Assumptions used: p95 response tokens (chat) = 600, cache hit = 30%, session affinity moderate, model = open-gpt-7B-quant (best latency/cost balance).

Preliminary pilot recommendation (30-day pilot with burst buffer):
- Reserved capacity: 8 GPUs (A100-40 equivalent performance units)
- Burst buffer: additional 2-3 GPU-equivalents to absorb 10-minute peaks
- Expected p95 tail latency with cont batching + KV cache: ~650-800 ms (depends on multi-turn cache hit)
- Expected sustained monthly token throughput covered by reserved: ~4.8B tokens (billing model and unit economics in term sheet)

Risks / items that materially change the above: 1) higher p99 token sizes, 2) real-world cache hit worse than 20%, 3) streaming outputs >1k tokens.

Next steps: Irene to send the template and schedule the 30-minute walkthrough; once we have histograms I’ll run a cost-sensitivity run and attach a draft term sheet.

- Marissa
Senior Pre-sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@veridian.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Oct 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial sizing inputs for dedicated capacity (Veridian)

Thanks — attaching the completed redwood_sizing_template.xlsx and a short note on cache behavior. Key clarifications: 

- We keep full chat context up to 2,000 tokens but apply a rolling truncate after 30 turns for very long sessions (rare).
- Measured cache hit (96-hour sample): prefix reuse ~28%, KV reuse for session context ~46% when users re-ask follow-ups within 5 minutes.
- Peak simultaneous sessions observed during window: 420 sessions (concurrent sockets).

We’re happy to do the 10am ET call tomorrow to walk through — Samir and Jordan will be on. Also attached is our initial term sheet (veridian_term_sheet.pdf) — nothing final, just expectations on commit length and price bands.

Look forward to the pilot sizing and the draft term sheet.

Samir
Head of Platform, Veridian AI

Attachments: redwood_sizing_template.xlsx (completed), veridian_term_sheet.pdf (draft)
